description: This file defines an abstract class 'Operator' within the 'Matrix\Operators' namespace, providing common functionalities for matrix operations, including validation of matrix dimensions and returning the result matrix.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared validation and result functionalities for matrix operations.

methods.description: Validates that two matrices have matching dimensions for addition or subtraction.
